tasks.title: Option to add project from git

Full access does not give full access

tasks.title: Global hotkey to show/hide the desktop window
tasks.notes: Tauri wrapper lives in desktop/. Use tauri-plugin-global-shortcut and reuse toggle_window in desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs; consider making the shortcut configurable in Settings.

tasks.title: Desktop app: alert when Claude needs approval while the window is in the tray
tasks.notes: The in-app approval popup (web/src/components/ApprovalPopups.tsx) only shows while the window is open, and the Tauri window has no notification plugin, so the browser Notification API in web/src/lib/notify.ts may not fire there. Add tauri-plugin-notification (or flash/show the window) when a permission request arrives and the window is hidden.

tasks.title: Tauri does not allow for drag and drop in swimlanes
Review a task's changes before Done
tasks.notes: Show the git diff a task session produced on its card, with Commit, Revert and Ask for changes buttons. Safety net now that task sessions run in Full access. Covers the 'Simple file explorer to keep track of edited files' task.

tasks.title: Plan first, then build
tasks.notes: Per-task option to start the session in Plan mode. Show the plan on the card to approve, then continue the same session in the project's task mode.

tasks.title: Run tasks in parallel in git worktrees
tasks.notes: Today one task runs at a time per project. Give each task its own worktree and branch so several can run at once; review becomes 'merge this branch'.

tasks.title: Cost and usage tracking
tasks.notes: Runs already report costUsd and numTurns. Show totals per project, per task and per day.

tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.notes: Recurring tasks (e.g. 'Every Monday: update dependencies and run tests') that land on the board and run themselves.

tasks.title: Project health on the overview
tasks.notes: Per project: uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, last test result, stale branch warning.

tasks.title: Dev server buttons per project
tasks.notes: Start and stop a project's dev command (npm run dev etc.) from its page, with logs and an 'open preview' link.

tasks.title: Search across Claude session history
tasks.notes: Full-text search over all sessions in History, e.g. 'where did I fix that auth bug?'.
